title: The Cosmic Parking Spot You Can Use Forever

segments.text: What if you could park a satellite forever?
A Lagrange point is a natural parking spot in the heavens where the Sun’s pull, Earth’s tug, and the centrifugal push all balance.
A tiny object placed there needs almost no fuel to stay put.
There are five such points for any two orbital bodies.
One sits directly between Earth and the Sun, another just beyond Earth’s night side.
Those spots let a spacecraft stay with minimal orbit corrections.
In short, a Lagrange point lets a satellite remain with very little station‑keeping.
